subject: Mutual plan + 21-day eval: template & proposed sprint
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Alec Morris <alec.morris@pioneerhealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan + 21-day eval: template & proposed sprint

Hi Alec —

Thanks again for the chat this morning. As promised, I put together a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) template and a companion 2-slide evaluation deck to help Pioneer Health run a focused 21-day trial. The goal here is to make the path to acceptance concrete: tasks, owners, dependencies, and a simple acceptance matrix.

Quick overview (in the doc):
- Phase 0 (Week 0): kickoff + env prep (VPC details, test data scope)
- Phase 1 (Days 1–14): integration + accuracy/latency checkpoints + weekly syncs
- Phase 2 (Days 15–21): acceptance runs, sampling, runbook handoff
- Acceptance criteria: SLOs for 95th pct latency, embedding accuracy thresholds, and a short UAT checklist

Please take a look at the shared doc and the two-slide deck below. I’ve also added a short RACI (owner = Redwood PM / Pioneer Eng / Pioneer CS) that we can edit live. If this looks good, we’d like to propose a technical kickoff later this week so our infra engineer can scope network requirements.

GDoc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xQ_map_quickstarter_v1
Slides (attachment): 21d-eval-slide-deck_v1.pptx

Action: Can you confirm the ideal stakeholders (eng, security, procurement) and two good time windows for a 60-min kickoff this week?

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Alec Morris <alec.morris@pioneerhealth.io>

Subject: Re: Mutual plan + 21-day eval: template & proposed sprint

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear outline and the doc. This is helpful. A few quick notes from our side after an internal sync:

- Security: we’ll need a short completed security questionnaire (SOC2 scoping + token handling) before the kickoff. Can you share the standard kit?
- Data: the trial will run on anonymized test data; we’ll share a sample by Wed. Please confirm we can pin the model version during the trial.
- Acceptance: the team would prefer a small synthetic test set for accuracy checks in addition to the UAT checklist. Can Redwood help generate a 50-case synthetic set?

Stakeholders to include:
- Sandra Lee (Eng lead) <sandra.lee@pioneerhealth.io>
- Vikram Patel (Security) <vikram@pioneerhealth.io>
- procurement@pioneerhealth.io

For kickoff windows this week, we can do:
- Wed 18 May, 10–11am PT
- Thu 19 May, 2–3pm PT

I’ll loop Sandra and Vikram if you confirm which slot works. Also copy of procurement is on for initial contract questions.

Best,
Alec
